page.title: Asset Delivery
page.subtitle: Verify this episode's available shot media, preview selected clips, and create a trustworthy handoff ZIP for post-production.

player.noMedia: This shot has no preview media yet.

access.viewerReason: You are a read-only viewer. Edit access is required to create or recreate the Asset Delivery ZIP.
access.viewerCancelReason: You are a read-only viewer. Edit access is required to cancel an Asset Delivery ZIP build.

package.title: Asset Delivery ZIP
package.description: Delivery status and download links are verified by the project-scoped delivery service. Database storage keys are never used directly here.
package.downloadHint: Delivery status and the link are verified before download. The ZIP is a post-production handoff and is not presented as an edited movie.
package.boundary: An Asset Delivery ZIP is not an MP4 movie. Creating it only packages existing files; it does not run AI generation or incur AI charges.
package.serverCannotCreate: The delivery service found no packageable assets. Complete a video, image, or voice asset first.
package.statusError: The Asset Delivery status cannot be loaded right now.
package.cachedStatus: The delivery status refresh failed. Showing the last verified result.
package.invalidDownload: The download link could not be verified safely, so the download action is hidden.
package.errorFallback: Creating the Asset Delivery ZIP failed.

receipt.staleNotice: Sources changed. This is the previous asset package.
receipt.legacyNotice: This is a legacy package without a manifest. It can be downloaded but is not presented as verified.

job.checking: Checking for an existing Asset Delivery ZIP build…
job.statusError: The Asset Delivery ZIP build status cannot be verified. Creating another build is paused to prevent duplicates.
job.cachedStatus: The build status refresh failed. Showing the last verified job state.
job.unavailableReason: An active build check must complete before another request can be submitted.
job.cannotCancelReason: This build cannot be cancelled right now.
job.cancelErrorFallback: Cancelling the Asset Delivery ZIP build failed.
job.latestFailedDescription: The previous package can still be downloaded, but it is not the result of this failed build. Check the sources before retrying.
